title: Gemini Gains Access to Google Wallet: Tickets, Expenses, and Rewards via Voice Commands
key_facts: Gemini can now access Google Wallet via the @Google Wallet command or the Connected Apps list.
It can find boarding passes, tickets and loyalty cards, summarise spending and list card rewards.
Spending analysis needs a bank account linked to Google Wallet through Plaid.
Gemini cannot start payments or change financial accounts; 9to5Google says this is intentional.
Android Authority says the phased rollout began 29 Sep 2026.
Rollout is U.S. only, personal Google accounts only; no date for Germany or Europe.
Access is opt-in and can be revoked.
quote_evidence: It cannot initiate payments or make changes to accounts, however; Google has intentionally disabled these features.
Technically, Gemini is limited to read-only access; according to all sources available so far, the AI cannot initiate a transaction.
why_it_matters_hint: Gemini can read Wallet data but not spend money.
event_date: Rollout began 29 Sep 2026 (per Android Authority, as cited)
notes: Older news re-dated: rollout started 29 Sep 2026. Basic Tutorials relays 9to5Google and Android Authority; the privacy worries in the article are the outlet’s own view.
